description: En wλve, creemos que cada señal cuenta una historia, cada descubrimiento despierta curiosidad y que cada idea tiene el potencial de inspirar un cambio. Somos aspirantes a ingenieros con un propósito mayor: aprender, descubrir e inspirar a otros a ver el mundo a través de la ciencia y la posibilidad.
summary: We developed a window to scientific information to inspire every brain on earth, we focus on transforming cold data into comprehensible visuals. We go further away together if everyone is well-equipped.
details:
Our project uses public NISAR data, filtered by area, time and set parameters to help visualize information, it translates extensive and hard-to-understand data collected by the NISAR mission to easy-to-digest maps and graphs that update in real-time to inspire every curious mind that reaches our tool. With in-depth details for those looking for more technical knowledge. You can toggle between Intuitive mode and Technical mode to find the right data for your project. By making scientific information accessible to everyone, we hope to be reachable to every human brain on earth.
